config_section_auto_switch_type_cidr_mal.message: Invalid CIDR. Please use the format like `192.168.1.1/24` or `2001:db8::/32`

config_section_auto_switch_help_domain.message: Matches the host name with wildcards: * matches any characters (dots included), ? matches one. "example.com" matches that host only; add "*.example.com" for its subdomains. Ports and paths aren't part of the match.

config_section_auto_switch_help_url.message:
Matches the whole URL with wildcards (* and ?), e.g. "http://example.com/api/*".
Browsers hide the path and query of https:// URLs from proxy rules (Chrome since version 52, Firefox since 51), so an https:// pattern can only match up to the host, e.g. "https://example.com/*".

config_section_auto_switch_help_regex.message:
A JavaScript regular expression tested against the whole URL. It is case-sensitive and matches anywhere in the URL unless anchored with ^ and $$, e.g. "^https?://(www\.)?example\.com/".
Browsers hide the path and query of https:// URLs from proxy rules (Chrome since version 52, Firefox since 51): an https:// URL is seen as "https://example.com/" only, so its path can't be matched.

config_section_auto_switch_help_cidr.message: Matches requests to an IP address in the range, e.g. "192.168.0.0/16" or "2001:db8::/32". A request by host name matches when the name resolves into the range, which costs a DNS lookup.

config_section_auto_switch_help_disabled.message: The rule is kept but skipped, until you pick a condition type again.

sync_desc.message: Sync your profiles and preferences across browsers and devices with a byte.vet account.

sync_privacy_note.message: Profiles sync with everything in them, including proxy usernames and passwords. They're sent over an encrypted connection, stored encrypted, and used only to keep your devices in sync. Mark a profile "This device only" to keep it off the cloud.

sync_signin_expired.message: The sign-in of $1 expired. Sign in again to keep syncing.

sync_signout_confirm.message: Stop syncing on this browser? Your profiles stay here.

sync_status_failed.message: $1 item(s) couldn't be synced: the server refused them. Edit them to try again.

sync_status_held.message: $1 item(s) were synced by a newer Proxyverse and can't be read by this version. Update Proxyverse to use them.

sync_error_clock_skew.message: Synced $1, but some changes were refused because this device's clock is ahead. Check the system clock.

sync_error_unreachable.message: Sync failed $1: byte.vet can't be reached. Proxyverse will retry.

sync_error_client_too_old.message: Sync stopped $1: this version of Proxyverse is too old. Update it to keep syncing.

sync_error_quota.message: Sync failed $1: the account is full. Delete some profiles.

sync_prefs_hint.message: Theme, language and toolbar button behavior. Turn off to keep this browser's own.

sync_snapshots_hint.message: byte.vet keeps copies of your synced data, so a bad change can be undone.

sync_snapshots_desc.message: Restoring a snapshot replaces the synced data on every device. A snapshot of the current data is taken first.

sync_restore_confirm.message: Replace the synced data on every device with this snapshot?

sync_restore_done.message: Restored. Other devices get it when they next sync.

sync_first_desc.message: Both this browser and your byte.vet account have profiles. How should they be combined?

sync_first_merge_hint.message: Keep everything. Where both have the same profile, this browser's wins.

sync_first_cloud_hint.message: Replace this browser's profiles with the account's.

sync_first_cloud_confirm.message: Profiles that are only in this browser will be deleted. Continue?

sync_first_upload_hint.message: Replace the account's profiles with this browser's, on every device. A snapshot is taken first.

sync_first_upload_confirm.message: Profiles that are only in the account will be deleted on every device. Continue?

profile_local_only_hint.message: Never sync this profile. Other devices keep the copy they already have.

profile_local_only_referenced.message: Synced profiles route to this one: $1. On other devices those rules will point to a missing profile.
